name: SciFact (via BEIR)

splits: test = official BEIR test queries; no train split (transfer protocol)

name: NFCorpus (via BEIR)

name: SciDocs (via BEIR)

per_head_signals: derived (facet views) but facet semantics are citation-graph-specific
decision_rationale: facet semantics differ from field splits; include only if C2 facet-validation passes

name: Amazon Shopping Queries (ESCI) English subset
license_verify_at_download: reported CC BY-4.0 - verify at repo
queries: ~2-5k queries subset with qrels kept intact
per_head_signals: derived (field views) + sparse BM25 view over same text
derived_signal_model: same pinned MiniLM; BM25 text identical export
splits: subset built from official train split ONLY; official test split untouched for reporting
leakage_risk: medium (subset construction must preserve qrels closure)
decision_rationale: strongest native multi-field graded labels; requires preregistered subsampling protocol (qrels-closure filter) + host RAM smoke

name: COCO Captions val2017 subset (5k images)
label_structure: exact-match ground truth (caption->its image) + optional class-level
modalities_or_facets: IMAGE embedding vs TEXT caption embedding (two genuinely different spaces)
derived_signal_model: openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 (MIT) pinned+hashed - CPU encode feasibility unproven
splits: caption-level split (train captions vs held-out query captions)
decision_rationale: only candidate with NATIVE independent-space heads; blocked on C2 encode-time smoke (est 25-60 min for 5k images on 2 vCPU)

name: GloVe 25-d angular (ann-benchmarks)
license_verify_at_download: dataset from ann-benchmarks (GloVe: CC-BY / Ir - record at download)
label_structure: exact top-100 NN ground truth (ANN-GT not semantic)
decision_rationale: official precomputed exact GT; perfect for recall-latency curves at host scale; explicitly NOT semantic evidence

name: NYTimes 256-d angular (ann-benchmarks)
decision_rationale: 290k rung; may exceed comfortable host RAM with external engines - abort per guardrails

name: MS MARCO passage
decision_rationale: exceeds host RAM by far; no field structure for heads; no smaller official variant with qrels closure

name: Flickr8K
